titles.title: Secure Rural Schools and Community Self-Determination Clarification Act
Secure Rural Schools and Community Self-Determination Clarification Act

A bill to amend the Secure Rural Schools and Community Self-Determination Act of 2000 to restore the full 75-percent payment to counties from the Oregon and California land-grant fund, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
